name: MONOREPO-001-F01 Preserve Calendar when moving to app-suite

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S01 Build and verify Calendar from the migrated repository

steps.text: the app-suite checkout has the documented Calendar build prerequisites
the owner's existing Calendar release credentials are available outside the checkout
the owner runs the documented Calendar unit tests, acceptance generator tests, UI acceptance, lint, debug build, release build and release artifact verification
each command exits successfully
the documented output paths contain a debug APK and a signed release APK for app.local.calendar
release artifact verification confirms the existing release certificate and distinct debug certificate

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S02 Continue using the installed Calendar after migration

steps.text: the dedicated offline Android test device has the pre-migration debug Calendar installed without Google Play services
the device date is 2028-02-15 in time zone UTC with English United States locale and 24-hour time
the operator updates Calendar with the migrated debug APK without uninstalling it or clearing data
the operator launches Calendar, opens February 20 from Month, returns to Month using system Back, and selects Week
the update succeeds for app.local.calendar without a second Calendar installation
February contains 7 columns and 6 rows with 42 consecutive dates from 2028-01-31 through 2028-03-12
selecting February 20 opens Day for February 20
system Back from Day returns to February in Month
Week displays February 14 through February 20 without an account or network requirement

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S03 Refuse a release build without the existing signing credentials

steps.text: the app-suite checkout has the documented Calendar build prerequisites
the release signing location selected for this invocation contains no credentials
the owner runs the documented Calendar release build
the command exits unsuccessfully with a missing signing credentials explanation
no newly built Calendar release APK is offered as ready for publication
no replacement signing key is created and no debug signing fallback is used
